title: Waits & Tasks
description: Inspect pending event waits and task envelopes; signal a wait or broadcast an event (docs/64 J-2c).
broadcastHint: Broadcast by eventKey; releases every wait on the key, or queues when no consumer is waiting.
payloadInvalid: Payload must be a valid JSON object
framesHint: Read-only view: no replay, no frame clearing. "Claimed yet still suspended" is what a crashed resume leaves behind (docs/76).
framesEmpty: No suspension points in this tenant (under Postgres this really means none)
framesNotPersisted: Memory backend: suspension frames are never persisted, so this table is always empty. An empty list does not mean no stuck runs — only the Postgres backend writes this table.
stateFrameLingering: Claimed · run terminal, frame left behind
